# Awesome Chilean RSS App

> A searchable directory for downloading RSS feeds from Chilean news, regional, technology, sports, culture, and public-data sources.

## Use the directory

- [Open Awesome Chilean RSS App](https://alplox.github.io/awesome-chilean-rss-app/): browse feeds by category or region, search sites, and export the selected feeds as OPML or HTML bookmarks.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/alplox/awesome-chilean-rss-app): inspect the application source and deployment configuration.
- [Feed directory data](https://github.com/alplox/awesome-chilean-rss): browse the source dataset and contribution guidelines.

## What the site provides

The application reads the public feed directory, lets visitors filter the catalogue, select individual feeds, and generate a portable bookmark file. Feed status, proxy, and duplicate metadata are shown when available.
